searchText: I finally read the addressing proposal and nothing immediately jumps out at me as a problem, though at the moment my mind isn't properly in the right context to expect that to happen. What I think would help me gain confidence is if each of the opcodes mentioned here were discussed in a nice list with a short blurb why they aren't a problem: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/increasing-address-size-from-20-to-32-bytes/5485/30 The reason is mainly to just give *me* (a casual reader) confidence that *someone* has gone through all of the opcodes that touch addresses and "thought about them" while in the proper mental context. I suspect that none will cause any problems, but it is nice to know that someone has spent time thinking through all of those scenarios. What happens if an address is looked up before the mapping is created? Can a contract send to an unmapped address?
